approved_by_note: 僅供課堂展示，未經臨床驗證，也未經任何醫師或藥師核可。數字與間隔皆來自文中所列公開來源（2026-11-25 查閱）；實際續開一律由醫師決定。 / Classroom demo only. Not clinically validated and not approved by any physician or pharmacist. Numbers and intervals come from the public sources cited (checked 2026-11-25); a physician always decides on renewal.

questions.label_zh: 這顆藥，你最近都是照醫師交代的方式吃嗎？
questions.label_en: Have you been taking this medicine the way your doctor told you to?
questions.help_zh: 漏吃、晚吃、自己調量或停藥，都請如實選，醫師看了才能判斷。
questions.help_en: Missed or late doses, changing the dose yourself or stopping all matter. Please answer honestly so the doctor can judge.

options.label_en: I sometimes miss or delay doses

options.label_zh: 我自己調整過劑量或次數
options.label_en: I changed the dose or timing myself

rules.reason_zh: 偶爾漏吃或晚吃，請醫師確認目前的用法。
rules.reason_en: You sometimes miss or delay doses; the doctor should confirm how you are taking it.

rules.reason_zh: 你自己調整過劑量或次數，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: You changed the dose or timing yourself; the doctor should confirm.

rules.reason_zh: 你已經停藥一陣子，重新開始前需要先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: You stopped the medicine for a while; a visit is needed before restarting.

questions.label_zh: 你現在有沒有胸痛、呼吸很喘、快要昏倒、單側手腳無力或說話不清楚，或嘴唇、喉嚨腫起來？
questions.label_en: Right now, do you have chest pain, severe breathlessness, near-fainting, one-sided weakness or slurred speech, or swelling of the lips or throat?
questions.help_zh: 只要有其中一項，請先不要填表。
questions.help_en: If any of these apply, please stop filling in this form.

rules.reason_zh: 這些症狀可能很危急，請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: These symptoms can be an emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 和上次看診比起來，有沒有出現新的不舒服，或原本的症狀變嚴重？
questions.label_en: Compared with your last visit, are there any new symptoms, or have existing ones got worse?

rules.reason_zh: 症狀有變化，續藥前需要先回診讓醫師看。
rules.reason_en: Symptoms have changed; a visit is needed before renewal.

questions.label_zh: 吃這顆藥之後，有沒有覺得不舒服、疑似是藥的副作用？
questions.label_en: Do you think this medicine is causing side effects?
questions.help_zh: 例如頭暈、胃不舒服、起疹子、咳嗽、很想睡。
questions.help_en: For example dizziness, stomach upset, rash, cough or drowsiness.

rules.reason_zh: 你覺得可能有副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: You suspect a side effect; the doctor should look at it.

questions.label_zh: 上次看診之後，有沒有對藥物或食物出現過敏，例如起疹子、癢或腫？
questions.label_en: Since your last visit, have you had any new allergic reaction to a medicine or food, such as rash, itching or swelling?

rules.reason_zh: 出現新的過敏反應，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: A new allergic reaction was reported; the doctor should look at it.

questions.label_zh: 上次看診之後，有沒有新增其他藥物、成藥、中藥或保健食品？
questions.label_en: Since your last visit, have you started any other medicine, over-the-counter product, herbal remedy or supplement?
questions.help_zh: 有些藥或保健食品會影響這顆藥的作用。
questions.help_en: Some products change how this medicine works.

rules.reason_zh: 有新增藥物或保健食品，請醫師確認是否互相影響。
rules.reason_en: New medicines or supplements were added; the doctor should check for interactions.

questions.label_zh: 上次看診之後，有沒有住院或掛過急診？
questions.label_en: Since your last visit, have you been admitted to hospital or gone to the emergency room?

rules.reason_zh: 住院或急診後，續藥前需要先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: After a hospital stay or ER visit, a visit is needed before renewal.

questions.label_zh: 你目前有懷孕、準備懷孕或正在哺乳嗎？
questions.label_en: Are you pregnant, planning a pregnancy or breastfeeding?
questions.help_zh: 不會懷孕的人請選「不適用」。
questions.help_en: If pregnancy is not possible for you, choose Not applicable.

rules.reason_zh: 懷孕期間用藥要由醫師重新評估，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Medicines in pregnancy need a doctor reassessment; please visit first.

rules.reason_zh: 準備懷孕前，用藥要先由醫師評估，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Before a planned pregnancy the medicine needs a doctor reassessment; please visit first.

rules.reason_zh: 哺乳期間用藥要由醫師重新評估，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Medicines while breastfeeding need a doctor reassessment; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 距離上次當面看診已經幾天？
questions.label_en: How many days ago was your last in-person visit?
questions.help_zh: 系統會依你的看診紀錄自動算出，不用自己填。
questions.help_en: The system works this out from your visit record; you do not need to enter it.

rules.reason_zh: 查不到上次當面看診的日期，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: No last in-person visit date was found; please visit first.

rules.reason_zh: 距離上次看診已超過 90 天（慢性病連續處方箋每次處方最長 90 天），請醫師確認是否需要先回診。
rules.reason_en: It is more than 90 days since your last visit (a refillable prescription covers at most 90 days); the doctor should decide whether a visit is needed first.

questions.label_zh: 上次看診之後，有沒有被告知腎臟或肝臟的狀況變差，或新診斷出腎臟病、肝病？
questions.label_en: Since your last visit, have you been told your kidney or liver condition got worse, or been newly diagnosed with kidney or liver disease?

rules.reason_zh: 腎臟或肝臟狀況有變，藥量可能要調整，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Kidney or liver status changed and the dose may need adjusting; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 你同意這份申請由醫師審核，並由醫師決定是否續開嗎？
questions.label_en: Do you agree that a doctor will review this request and decide whether to renew?
questions.help_zh: 本系統只做檢核，不會開藥。
questions.help_en: This tool only checks; it never prescribes.

rules.reason_zh: 需要你同意由醫師審核才能送出，否則請回診。
rules.reason_en: You must agree to doctor review to submit; otherwise please visit.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -pril 或 -sartan 結尾）用來控制血壓、保護腎臟，要留意咳嗽、血管性水腫、血鉀與腎功能，懷孕時不能用。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -pril or -sartan) lower blood pressure and protect the kidneys. Watch for cough, angioedema, potassium and kidney function; they must not be used in pregnancy.

questions.label_zh: 最近一週在家量血壓，早晚平均的收縮壓（上面的數字）是多少？
questions.label_en: Over the past week at home, what is your average systolic (top) blood pressure?
questions.help_zh: 請照「722」方式量：連續 7 天，早晚各量 2 次，每次量 2 回，再取平均。
questions.help_en: Use the 722 method: 7 days, morning and evening, 2 readings each time, then average.

rules.reason_zh: 沒有居家血壓數字，請醫師確認血壓控制情形。
rules.reason_en: No home blood pressure was given; the doctor should check blood pressure control.

rules.reason_zh: 居家平均收縮壓 130 mmHg 以上，高於台灣高血壓指引的目標（低於 130/80），請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Average home systolic is 130 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 同一段時間，早晚平均的舒張壓（下面的數字）是多少？
questions.label_en: Over the same time, what is your average diastolic (bottom) blood pressure?

rules.reason_zh: 沒有居家血壓數字，請醫師確認血壓控制情形。
rules.reason_en: No home blood pressure was given; the doctor should check blood pressure control.

rules.reason_zh: 居家平均舒張壓 80 mmHg 以上，高於台灣高血壓指引的目標（低於 130/80），請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Average home diastolic is 80 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 站起來的時候，會不會頭暈、眼前發黑，或差點跌倒？
questions.label_en: When you stand up, do you get dizzy, see black, or nearly fall?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是血壓太低或體位性低血壓，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Possible low blood pressure on standing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嘴唇、舌頭、臉或喉嚨突然腫起來？
questions.label_en: Recently, have your lips, tongue, face or throat suddenly swollen?

rules.reason_zh: 嘴唇、舌頭或喉嚨腫脹可能讓呼吸變困難，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat can block breathing. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有持續乾咳，而且是開始吃這類藥之後才有的？
questions.label_en: Do you have a dry cough that started after you began this medicine?

rules.reason_zh: 持續乾咳是 ACEI 常見的副作用，請醫師確認是否要換藥。
rules.reason_en: A persistent dry cough is a common ACE inhibitor side effect; the doctor should consider switching.

questions.label_zh: 最近 2 至 4 週內，你的劑量有調高或剛開始吃嗎？
questions.label_en: In the past 2 to 4 weeks, was your dose raised or did you just start this medicine?
questions.help_zh: 剛開始或調高劑量後，需要抽血看腎功能與血鉀。
questions.help_en: After starting or raising the dose, kidney function and potassium need checking by blood test.

rules.reason_zh: 剛開始或調高劑量後 2 至 4 週內要檢查血壓、肌酸酐與血鉀，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Blood pressure, creatinine and potassium should be checked within 2 to 4 weeks of starting or raising the dose; the doctor should confirm.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能與血鉀（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function and potassium (date of latest blood test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 指引對慢性腎臟病患者建議至少每年檢查一次腎功能；本系統對這類藥沿用相同間隔，這是保守的設定，最後由醫師決定。
monitoring.reason_en: KDIGO advises checking kidney function at least yearly in people with CKD; this tool applies the same interval to this class as a conservative setting, and the doctor makes the final call.

monitoring.label_zh: 居家血壓量測紀錄（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Home blood pressure log (date of latest check)
monitoring.reason_zh: 血壓控制穩定時，台灣指引建議約每 3 個月檢視一次居家血壓；超過這段時間沒量，請先補量。
monitoring.reason_en: When blood pressure is controlled, the Taiwan guideline suggests checking home blood pressure about every 3 months; if it has been longer, please measure again first.

classes.title_zh: 降血壓藥：鈣離子阻斷劑
classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 amlodipine、nifedipine）用來控制血壓，常見副作用是腳踝水腫、臉潮紅與頭痛。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as amlodipine and nifedipine) lower blood pressure. Ankle swelling, flushing and headache are common side effects.

rules.reason_en: Average home systolic is 130 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 同一段時間，早晚平均的舒張壓（下面的數字）是多少？

rules.reason_zh: 沒有居家血壓數字，請醫師確認血壓控制情形。
rules.reason_en: No home blood pressure was given; the doctor should check blood pressure control.

rules.reason_zh: 居家平均舒張壓 80 mmHg 以上，高於台灣高血壓指引的目標（低於 130/80），請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Average home diastolic is 80 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_en: When you stand up, do you get dizzy, see black, or nearly fall?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是血壓太低或體位性低血壓，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Possible low blood pressure on standing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 腳踝或小腿有沒有新的水腫，或比之前更腫？
questions.label_en: Do you have new or worse swelling of the ankles or lower legs?

rules.reason_zh: 腳踝水腫是這類藥常見的副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Ankle swelling is a common side effect of this class; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有心跳很快、很用力，或胸口悶悶的感覺？
questions.label_en: Do you feel a fast or pounding heartbeat, or chest tightness?

rules.reason_zh: 心悸或胸悶需要先讓醫師當面評估。
rules.reason_en: Palpitations or chest tightness need a doctor to see you in person first.

monitoring.label_zh: 居家血壓量測紀錄（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Home blood pressure log (date of latest check)
monitoring.reason_zh: 血壓控制穩定時，台灣指引建議約每 3 個月檢視一次居家血壓；超過這段時間沒量，請先補量。
monitoring.reason_en: When blood pressure is controlled, the Taiwan guideline suggests checking home blood pressure about every 3 months; if it has been longer, please measure again first.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -olol 結尾）可降低血壓與心跳；突然停藥有風險，氣喘患者與心跳過慢的人要特別留意。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -olol) lower blood pressure and heart rate. Stopping suddenly is risky, and people with asthma or a very slow pulse need extra care.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有突然停過這類藥，或超過幾天沒吃？
questions.label_en: Recently, did you stop this medicine suddenly or go several days without it?

rules.reason_zh: 突然停用乙型阻斷劑可能讓心跳與血壓反彈，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Stopping a beta blocker suddenly can cause a rebound in heart rate and blood pressure; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有覺得心跳特別慢、很容易喘或很容易累？
questions.label_en: Does your pulse feel very slow, or do you get breathless or tired very easily?

rules.reason_zh: 心跳過慢或容易喘，請醫師確認藥量。
rules.reason_en: A very slow pulse or easy breathlessness; the doctor should review the dose.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有新的喘鳴聲或氣喘發作變多？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had new wheezing or more asthma attacks?

rules.reason_zh: 乙型阻斷劑可能讓氣喘惡化，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: Beta blockers can worsen asthma; please visit first.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 hydrochlorothiazide、indapamide）幫助排水降血壓，要留意脫水、抽筋、血鈉血鉀偏低與痛風。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as hydrochlorothiazide and indapamide) remove fluid to lower blood pressure. Watch for dehydration, cramps, low sodium or potassium, and gout.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子，或吃喝很少、脫水的情形？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had bad vomiting or diarrhoea, or eaten and drunk very little, or become dehydrated?

rules.reason_zh: 脫水或吃喝很少時，這類藥可能要暫停，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: When dehydrated or not eating or drinking, this medicine may need pausing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有常常抽筋、全身無力，或心跳不規律？
questions.label_en: Do you often get cramps or feel weak all over, or notice an irregular heartbeat?

rules.reason_zh: 抽筋、無力或心律不整可能是電解質失衡，請先回診抽血。
rules.reason_en: Cramps, weakness or an irregular heartbeat may mean an electrolyte imbalance; please visit for blood tests.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有痛風發作，例如腳趾、腳踝突然紅腫痛？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had a gout attack, such as a suddenly red, swollen, painful toe or ankle?

rules.reason_zh: 利尿劑可能讓尿酸升高，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Diuretics can raise uric acid; the doctor should review.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能與血鉀（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function and potassium (date of latest blood test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 指引對慢性腎臟病患者建議至少每年檢查一次腎功能；本系統對這類藥沿用相同間隔，這是保守的設定，最後由醫師決定。
monitoring.reason_en: KDIGO advises checking kidney function at least yearly in people with CKD; this tool applies the same interval to this class as a conservative setting, and the doctor makes the final call.

monitoring.label_zh: 居家血壓量測紀錄（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Home blood pressure log (date of latest check)
monitoring.reason_zh: 血壓控制穩定時，台灣指引建議約每 3 個月檢視一次居家血壓；超過這段時間沒量，請先補量。
monitoring.reason_en: When blood pressure is controlled, the Taiwan guideline suggests checking home blood pressure about every 3 months; if it has been longer, please measure again first.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥幫助降低壞膽固醇、減少心血管事件；要留意肌肉痠痛無力、茶色尿與肝功能。
classes.summary_en: These medicines lower LDL cholesterol and reduce heart and vessel events. Watch for muscle pain or weakness, dark urine and liver problems.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有不明原因的肌肉痠痛、無力或抽痛，尤其是大腿或肩膀？
questions.label_en: Do you have unexplained muscle pain, weakness or cramps, especially in the thighs or shoulders?

rules.reason_zh: 肌肉症狀可能與 statin 有關，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Muscle symptoms may be related to the statin; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 肌肉痠痛時，尿液有沒有變成茶色或可樂色？
questions.label_en: With muscle pain, has your urine turned tea- or cola-coloured?

rules.reason_zh: 肌肉痠痛加上茶色尿，可能是肌肉受損，請先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: Muscle pain with dark urine may mean muscle damage; please visit for tests.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有皮膚或眼白變黃、右上腹痛，或食慾變很差？
questions.label_en: Do you have yellow skin or eyes, pain in the upper right belly, or a much poorer appetite?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是肝臟問題，請先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: This may be a liver problem; please visit for tests.

monitoring.label_zh: 血脂檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Lipid panel (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: ACC/AHA 指引建議開始用藥或調藥後 4 至 12 週檢查血脂，之後依需要每 3 至 12 個月一次；超過 12 個月沒檢查就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: ACC/AHA advise a lipid check 4 to 12 weeks after starting or adjusting a statin, then every 3 to 12 months as needed; no check in over 12 months goes to the doctor.

classes.summary_zh: Metformin 是常用的第一線口服降血糖藥；腎功能太差時不能用，要留意腸胃不適與罕見但嚴重的乳酸中毒。
classes.summary_en: Metformin is a common first-line oral diabetes medicine. It must not be used when kidney function is too low; watch for stomach upset and the rare but serious lactic acidosis.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有持續的噁心、腹瀉或胃不舒服，是吃這個藥之後才有的？
questions.label_en: Do you have lasting nausea, diarrhoea or stomach upset since starting this medicine?

rules.reason_zh: 腸胃不適是常見副作用，請醫師確認是否要調整。
rules.reason_en: Stomach upset is a common side effect; the doctor should consider adjusting.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子，或吃喝很少、脫水的情形？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had bad vomiting or diarrhoea, or eaten and drunk very little, or become dehydrated?

rules.reason_zh: 脫水或吃喝很少時，這類藥可能要暫停，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: When dehydrated or not eating or drinking, this medicine may need pausing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 近期有沒有安排打顯影劑的檢查（例如電腦斷層）或手術？
questions.label_en: Do you have a scan with contrast dye (such as a CT) or surgery coming up?

rules.reason_zh: 做顯影劑檢查或手術前後，metformin 可能要暫停，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Metformin may need pausing around contrast scans or surgery; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有突然很喘、肌肉痠痛、很想吐、肚子痛，或異常疲倦？
questions.label_en: Do you have sudden breathlessness, muscle pain, nausea, belly pain or unusual tiredness?

rules.reason_zh: 這些可能是乳酸中毒的警訊，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: These may be signs of lactic acidosis. Seek care now.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能 eGFR（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function eGFR (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: eGFR 低於 30，metformin 不建議使用，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: eGFR below 30: metformin is contraindicated; please visit first.

rules.reason_zh: eGFR 低於 45，請醫師評估繼續使用的好處與風險。
rules.reason_en: eGFR below 45: the doctor should weigh the benefit and risk of continuing.

monitoring.reason_zh: 使用 metformin 的人至少每年檢查一次 eGFR，高風險者要更頻繁。
monitoring.reason_en: People on metformin should have eGFR checked at least yearly, more often if at higher risk.

monitoring.label_zh: 糖化血色素 HbA1c（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: HbA1c (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: 糖化血色素 7% 以上，高於多數成人的目標（低於 7%），請醫師確認；目標值可依個人情況調整。
rules.reason_en: HbA1c is 7% or higher, above the target for many adults (below 7%); the doctor should review. Targets can be individualised.

monitoring.reason_zh: 血糖穩定時至少每年檢查兩次，因此超過約半年沒有數值就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: At least twice a year when stable, so a value older than about six months goes to the doctor.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能 eGFR（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function eGFR (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的腎功能與尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists kidney function and urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 尿液白蛋白／肌酸酐比值 UACR（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 散瞳眼底檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Dilated eye exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 列出糖尿病患者每年做一次散瞳眼底檢查（沒有病變且血糖達標時，可考慮 1 至 2 年一次，由醫師決定）。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists an annual dilated eye exam for people with diabetes (every 1-2 years may be considered when there is no retinopathy and goals are met; the doctor decides).

monitoring.label_zh: 完整足部檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Comprehensive foot exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 建議糖尿病患者至少每年做一次完整的足部檢查。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA recommends a comprehensive foot exam at least once a year.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -gliptin 結尾）單獨使用時較少造成低血糖，要留意胰臟炎、關節痛與水泡。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -gliptin) rarely cause low blood sugar on their own. Watch for pancreatitis, joint pain and blisters.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有嚴重、持續不退的上腹痛，可能伴隨嘔吐？
questions.label_en: Do you have severe, lasting upper belly pain, possibly with vomiting?

rules.reason_zh: 持續的劇烈上腹痛可能是胰臟炎，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: Severe lasting upper belly pain may be pancreatitis. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有新的嚴重關節痛，痛到影響活動？

rules.reason_zh: 嚴重關節痛是這類藥已知的副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Severe joint pain is a known side effect of this class; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 皮膚有沒有出現水泡或大片脫皮？
questions.label_en: Do you have blisters or large areas of peeling skin?

rules.reason_zh: 皮膚水泡可能是藥物反應，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Skin blisters may be a drug reaction; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有新的腿腫、躺下會喘，或體重短時間內明顯增加？
questions.label_en: Do you have new leg swelling, breathlessness lying down, or quick weight gain?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是心臟衰竭的徵兆，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: These may be signs of heart failure; please visit first.

monitoring.label_zh: 糖化血色素 HbA1c（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: HbA1c (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: 糖化血色素 7% 以上，高於多數成人的目標（低於 7%），請醫師確認；目標值可依個人情況調整。
rules.reason_en: HbA1c is 7% or higher, above the target for many adults (below 7%); the doctor should review. Targets can be individualised.

monitoring.reason_zh: 血糖穩定時至少每年檢查兩次，因此超過約半年沒有數值就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: At least twice a year when stable, so a value older than about six months goes to the doctor.

monitoring.label_en: Kidney function eGFR (date of latest test)

monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists kidney function and urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_en: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 散瞳眼底檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Dilated eye exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 列出糖尿病患者每年做一次散瞳眼底檢查（沒有病變且血糖達標時，可考慮 1 至 2 年一次，由醫師決定）。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists an annual dilated eye exam for people with diabetes (every 1-2 years may be considered when there is no retinopathy and goals are met; the doctor decides).

monitoring.label_zh: 完整足部檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Comprehensive foot exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 建議糖尿病患者至少每年做一次完整的足部檢查。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA recommends a comprehensive foot exam at least once a year.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -gliflozin 結尾）讓糖分從尿液排出；要留意生殖器與泌尿道感染、脫水，以及罕見但嚴重的酮酸中毒。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -gliflozin) pass sugar out in the urine. Watch for genital and urinary infections, dehydration, and the rare but serious ketoacidosis.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有噁心、嘔吐、肚子痛、非常疲倦或呼吸急促？即使血糖不高也一樣。
questions.label_en: Do you have nausea, vomiting, belly pain, extreme tiredness or fast breathing, even if your blood sugar is not high?

rules.reason_zh: 這些可能是酮酸中毒的警訊，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: These may be signs of ketoacidosis. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有私密處搔癢、紅腫、分泌物，或排尿灼熱疼痛？
questions.label_en: Do you have genital itching, redness or discharge, or burning or pain when passing urine?

rules.reason_zh: 生殖器與泌尿道感染是這類藥的常見副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Genital and urinary infections are common side effects of this class; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子，或吃喝很少、脫水的情形？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had bad vomiting or diarrhoea, or eaten and drunk very little, or become dehydrated?

rules.reason_zh: 脫水或吃喝很少時，這類藥可能要暫停，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: When dehydrated or not eating or drinking, this medicine may need pausing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 近期有沒有安排手術，或需要長時間禁食的檢查？
questions.label_en: Do you have surgery or a test needing a long fast coming up?

rules.reason_zh: 手術或長時間禁食前，這類藥通常要暫停，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Before surgery or a long fast this medicine usually needs pausing; the doctor should review.

monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 列出糖尿病患者每年做一次散瞳眼底檢查（沒有病變且血糖達標時，可考慮 1 至 2 年一次，由醫師決定）。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists an annual dilated eye exam for people with diabetes (every 1-2 years may be considered when there is no retinopathy and goals are met; the doctor decides).

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 glimepiride、gliclazide）會刺激胰島素分泌，最大的風險是低血糖，吃得少或年紀大時更要小心。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as glimepiride and gliclazide) push the body to release insulin. The main risk is low blood sugar, especially when eating less or in older age.

questions.label_zh: 最近一個月，有沒有血糖過低的情形，例如冒冷汗、手抖、心悸、突然很餓？
questions.label_en: In the past month, have you had low blood sugar, such as cold sweats, shaking, a pounding heart or sudden hunger?
questions.help_zh: 如果有量到血糖，低於 70 mg/dL 就算過低。
questions.help_en: If you measured it, below 70 mg/dL counts as low.

options.label_zh: 有，血糖低於 70 mg/dL 或有這些症狀
options.label_en: Yes, below 70 mg/dL or with these symptoms

options.label_zh: 有，血糖低於 54 mg/dL，或需要別人幫忙
options.label_en: Yes, below 54 mg/dL or I needed help

rules.reason_zh: 有血糖低於 70 mg/dL 的情形，請醫師確認用藥。
rules.reason_en: Blood sugar fell below 70 mg/dL; the doctor should review the medicine.

rules.reason_zh: 血糖低於 54 mg/dL，或需要別人幫忙處理，續藥前請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Blood sugar fell below 54 mg/dL or you needed someone to help; please visit before renewal.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有吃得比平常少，或常常跳過正餐？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you been eating less than usual or often skipping meals?

rules.reason_zh: 吃得少時吃這類藥容易低血糖，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Taking this medicine while eating less makes low blood sugar more likely; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有因為頭暈、冒冷汗或意識模糊而跌倒，或開車時差點出事？
questions.label_en: Have you fallen, or nearly had a driving accident, because of dizziness, sweating or confusion?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是嚴重低血糖，續藥前請先回診。
rules.reason_en: This may be severe low blood sugar; please visit before renewal.

monitoring.label_en: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (date of latest test)

monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists an annual dilated eye exam for people with diabetes (every 1-2 years may be considered when there is no retinopathy and goals are met; the doctor decides).

classes.summary_zh: Levothyroxine 用來補充甲狀腺素；劑量過多或不足都會有症狀，要定期追蹤甲狀腺刺激素 TSH，懷孕時需要更密集追蹤。
classes.summary_en: Levothyroxine replaces thyroid hormone. Too much or too little both cause symptoms; TSH needs regular follow-up, and pregnancy needs closer monitoring.

questions.label_zh: 最近 6 週內，你的劑量有調整過嗎？
questions.label_en: In the past 6 weeks, was your dose changed?

rules.reason_zh: 調整劑量後約 4 至 6 週才適合再測 TSH，請醫師確認時機。
rules.reason_en: TSH is usually rechecked about 4 to 6 weeks after a dose change; the doctor should confirm the timing.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有心悸、手抖、很怕熱、容易流汗，或體重不明原因下降？
questions.label_en: Do you have a pounding heart, tremor, heat intolerance, sweating, or unexplained weight loss?

rules.reason_zh: 這些可能是藥量偏多的症狀，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: These may be signs of too much medicine; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有很怕冷、容易累、反應變慢、便祕或體重增加？
questions.label_en: Do you feel very cold, tired or slow, constipated, or have you gained weight?

rules.reason_zh: 這些可能是藥量不足的症狀，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: These may be signs of too little medicine; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 你有沒有常常和鈣片、鐵劑或制酸劑一起吃，或沒有空腹吃？
questions.label_en: Do you often take it together with calcium, iron or antacids, or not on an empty stomach?

rules.reason_zh: 吃法可能影響吸收，請醫師或藥師說明正確吃法。
rules.reason_en: How you take it may affect absorption; the doctor or pharmacist should explain.

monitoring.label_zh: 甲狀腺刺激素 TSH（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: TSH (date of latest blood test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 劑量穩定後，指引建議約每年追蹤一次 TSH；超過一年沒檢查就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: Once the dose is stable, guidance suggests checking TSH about once a year; no test in over a year goes to the doctor.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（alpha 阻斷劑如 tamsulosin、silodosin，以及 5-alpha 還原酶抑制劑如 finasteride、dutasteride）改善排尿；要留意完全解不出尿、血尿、站起來頭暈。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (alpha blockers such as tamsulosin and silodosin, and 5-alpha reductase inhibitors such as finasteride and dutasteride) ease urination. Watch for being unable to pass urine, blood in urine, and dizziness on standing.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有突然完全解不出尿，或膀胱脹痛卻排不出來？
questions.label_en: Have you suddenly been unable to pass urine at all, or had a painful full bladder you cannot empty?

rules.reason_zh: 完全解不出尿需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: Not being able to pass urine needs treatment right away. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 尿液有沒有帶血，或排尿時發燒、寒顫？
questions.label_en: Is there blood in your urine, or fever and chills with urination?

rules.reason_zh: 血尿或發燒需要先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: Blood in the urine or fever needs a visit for tests first.

questions.label_zh: 近期有沒有安排白內障手術？
questions.label_en: Do you have cataract surgery planned?

rules.reason_zh: 白內障手術前要告知眼科醫師你有吃 alpha 阻斷劑，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Tell the eye surgeon you take an alpha blocker before cataract surgery; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有性慾下降、勃起困難，或射精量變少而困擾你？
questions.label_en: Are you bothered by lower sex drive, erection problems or less ejaculate?

rules.reason_zh: 這些是這類藥可能的副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: These can be side effects of this class; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 站起來的時候，會不會頭暈、眼前發黑，或差點跌倒？
questions.label_en: When you stand up, do you get dizzy, see black, or nearly fall?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是血壓太低或體位性低血壓，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Possible low blood pressure on standing; the doctor should review.

classes.summary_zh: 低劑量阿斯匹靈、clopidogrel 用來預防血栓；最主要的風險是出血，裝過支架的人不能自行停藥。
classes.summary_en: Low-dose aspirin and clopidogrel prevent clots. The main risk is bleeding, and people with stents must not stop on their own.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有解黑色柏油狀的大便、吐血，或吐出像咖啡渣的東西？
questions.label_en: Have you passed black tarry stools, vomited blood, or vomited something like coffee grounds?

rules.reason_zh: 這可能是消化道出血，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: This may be bleeding in the digestive tract. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 你吃這個藥主要是為了什麼？
questions.label_en: What is the main reason you take this medicine?

options.label_zh: 裝過心臟支架，或發生過心肌梗塞、中風
options.label_en: After a stent, heart attack or stroke

rules.reason_zh: 裝過支架或發生過心肌梗塞、中風，停藥時機要由醫師決定，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: After a stent, heart attack or stroke, the doctor decides when to stop; the doctor should review.

rules.reason_zh: 不確定吃藥原因，請醫師確認是否仍需要。
rules.reason_en: You are not sure why you take it; the doctor should confirm it is still needed.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有容易瘀青、流鼻血不容易止住、牙齦常出血，或血尿？
questions.label_en: Recently, do you bruise easily, have nosebleeds that are hard to stop, bleeding gums or blood in the urine?

rules.reason_zh: 出血傾向變多，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: More bleeding than usual; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 近期有沒有安排手術、拔牙或內視鏡檢查？
questions.label_en: Do you have surgery, a tooth extraction or an endoscopy planned?

rules.reason_zh: 侵入性處置前，抗血小板藥是否要暫停要由醫師決定。
rules.reason_en: Whether to pause an antiplatelet before a procedure is the doctor's decision.

classes.title_zh: 氫離子幫浦抑制劑（胃藥）
classes.summary_zh: PPI（如 omeprazole、esomeprazole、pantoprazole）抑制胃酸；長期使用要定期確認是否仍需要，並留意警訊症狀。
classes.summary_en: PPIs (such as omeprazole, esomeprazole and pantoprazole) reduce stomach acid. Long-term use should be reviewed regularly, and alarm symptoms watched for.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有解黑色柏油狀的大便，或吐血？
questions.label_en: Have you passed black tarry stools or vomited blood?

rules.reason_zh: 這可能是消化道出血，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: This may be bleeding in the digestive tract. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有吞嚥困難、不明原因體重下降、反覆嘔吐，或被告知有貧血？
questions.label_en: Do you have trouble swallowing, unexplained weight loss, repeated vomiting, or have you been told you are anaemic?

rules.reason_zh: 這些是需要檢查的警訊，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: These are warning signs that need tests; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 過去一年內，醫師有跟你討論過是否還需要繼續吃這類胃藥嗎？
questions.label_en: In the past year, has a doctor discussed whether you still need this stomach medicine?

rules.reason_zh: 長期使用的胃藥要定期評估是否仍需要，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Long-term acid medicine should be reviewed regularly; the doctor should confirm it is still needed.

classes.summary_zh: Allopurinol、febuxostat 用來把血中尿酸控制在目標以下、減少痛風發作；要留意嚴重皮疹，febuxostat 有心血管疾病的使用限制。
classes.summary_en: Allopurinol and febuxostat keep blood uric acid below target and reduce gout attacks. Watch for severe rash, and febuxostat has cardiovascular cautions.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有出現全身紅疹、口腔潰瘍、水泡或發燒？
questions.label_en: Do you have a widespread rash, mouth ulcers, blisters or fever?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是嚴重的藥物過敏反應，請立刻停藥並就醫。
rules.reason_en: This may be a severe drug allergy. Stop the medicine and seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 最近三個月有沒有痛風發作？
questions.label_en: Have you had a gout attack in the past three months?

rules.reason_zh: 仍有痛風發作，請醫師確認劑量是否足夠。
rules.reason_en: Gout attacks continue; the doctor should check whether the dose is enough.

questions.label_zh: 你有沒有心臟病、心肌梗塞或中風的病史，或最近剛發生？
questions.label_en: Do you have a history of heart disease, heart attack or stroke, or has one just happened?

rules.reason_zh: 有心血管疾病的人使用 febuxostat 要特別評估，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: In people with cardiovascular disease, febuxostat needs special assessment; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有皮膚或眼白變黃，或右上腹痛？
questions.label_en: Do you have yellow skin or eyes, or pain in the upper right belly?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是肝臟問題，請先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: This may be a liver problem; please visit for tests.

monitoring.label_zh: 血清尿酸（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: Serum uric acid (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: 尿酸 6 mg/dL 以上，高於 ACR 指引的目標（低於 6），請醫師確認劑量。
rules.reason_en: Uric acid is 6 mg/dL or higher, above the ACR target (below 6); the doctor should check the dose.

monitoring.reason_zh: ACR 指引要求調整劑量後都要測尿酸，但沒有固定的追蹤間隔，所以這裡只看數值、不設期限。
monitoring.reason_en: The ACR guideline asks for a uric acid check after each dose change but gives no fixed interval, so only the value is checked here and no age limit is set.

classes.summary_zh: 含吸入型類固醇的控制型吸入劑用來預防氣喘發作；這裡用 GINA 的四個問題確認最近四週的控制情形。
classes.summary_en: Inhaled-steroid controller inhalers prevent asthma attacks. The four GINA questions check control over the last four weeks.

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，白天有沒有每週超過 2 次的氣喘症狀？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did you have daytime asthma symptoms more than twice a week?

rules.reason_zh: 白天症狀偏多，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Frequent daytime symptoms; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，有沒有因為氣喘半夜醒來？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did asthma wake you at night?

rules.reason_zh: 夜裡會因氣喘醒來，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Night waking; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，需要用急救型（緩解）吸入劑的次數有沒有每週超過 2 次？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did you need your reliever inhaler more than twice a week?

rules.reason_zh: 急救用藥偏多，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Frequent reliever use; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，有沒有因為氣喘而影響日常活動？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did asthma limit your activities?

rules.reason_zh: 活動受限，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Activity limitation; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 過去一年內，有沒有因為氣喘發作而需要口服類固醇、掛急診或住院？
questions.label_en: In the past year, did an asthma attack need oral steroids, an ER visit or hospital admission?

rules.reason_zh: 過去一年有嚴重發作，是日後再發作的風險因子，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: A severe attack in the past year is a risk factor for future attacks; the doctor should review.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 cetirizine、fexofenadine）緩解過敏症狀；要留意嗜睡，以及症狀控制不佳或有嚴重過敏的警訊。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as cetirizine and fexofenadine) ease allergy symptoms. Watch for drowsiness, poor control, and signs of a severe allergy.

questions.label_zh: 過敏發作時，有沒有喘不過氣、喉嚨緊或臉、嘴唇腫起來？
questions.label_en: During an allergic reaction, have you had trouble breathing, a tight throat, or swelling of the face or lips?

rules.reason_zh: 這可能是嚴重過敏反應，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: This may be a severe allergic reaction. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 吃了之後會不會很想睡、影響開車或工作？
questions.label_en: Does it make you very sleepy or affect driving or work?

rules.reason_zh: 嗜睡影響生活，請醫師確認是否要換藥。
rules.reason_en: Drowsiness is affecting daily life; the doctor should consider another medicine.

questions.label_zh: 吃藥之後，過敏症狀（鼻水、打噴嚏、癢）還是很困擾你嗎？
questions.label_en: Even on the medicine, are allergy symptoms (runny nose, sneezing, itching) still bothering you a lot?

rules.reason_zh: 症狀控制不佳，請醫師確認是否要調整治療。
rules.reason_en: Symptoms are not well controlled; the doctor should consider changing treatment.

questions.label_zh: 除了過敏症狀，有沒有喘鳴或胸悶？
questions.label_en: Besides allergy symptoms, do you have wheezing or chest tightness?

rules.reason_zh: 可能合併氣喘，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: This may include asthma; please visit first.
